title: Unmapped State Deadlock (Missing Default)
bug_signature: UVM_FATAL: [FSM_LOCK] state=3'h6 detected; arbiter frozen for 10000 cycles
testbench: initial begin force state = 5; #10 release state; end
expected_root_cause: The FSM case statement handles only states 0–4 with no default branch; an illegal state (5, 6, or 7) reached via scan-shift or glitch causes the arbiter to freeze permanently.
description: The 3-bit FSM state register can reach values 5, 6, or 7 from a glitch or scan-shift; without a default case the arbiter freezes in that illegal state.
failure_log: UVM_FATAL: [FSM_LOCK] state=3'h6 detected; arbiter frozen for 10000 cycles
success_log: Illegal state injection test: state returns to 3'h0 within 1 cycle. No lockup.
